crossRefs.note: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs.…
I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and…

parallels.note: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.

people.name: Bela

people.name: Beor

people.name: Dinhabah

translations.web: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
translations.bsb: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites: Bela son of Beor. His city was named Dinhabah.
translations.kjv: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
translations.asv: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there resigned any king over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
